title: Optimization: the length of a quarter-wave matching section between an empty WR-90 guide and one filled with εr = 2.2, found by Nelder–Mead from 8 mm
source: Quarter-wave transformer: D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th ed., Wiley 2012, §2.5 and §5.4, with TE10 wave impedances Z = ωμ/β (§3.3); the section's εr makes β_m = √(β₁β₃), so Z_m = √(Z₁Z₃) and the reflection vanishes at l = π/(2β_m) = λg/4. The simplex: J. A. Nelder and R. Mead, Comput. J. 7(4):308–313, 1965

quantities.quantity: the optimum's length of the matching section (mm)
quantities.reason: the simplex stops within 1e-3 of the 14 mm range (0.014 mm); second-order elements of 3 mm put the section's β within about 1e-4: measured 0.002 mm

quantities.quantity: |S11| at 8 GHz of the model the optimization leaves
quantities.reason: matched: the model is left at the optimum (about 1e-4, the discretization's own reflection)
